tagline: Global leader in critical digital infrastructure for data centers, communication networks, and mission-critical environments
hero_kpi_rationale: Capacity Expansion is the Hero KPI as it reflects the company's strategy to meet growing demand for critical digital infrastructure solutions, particularly for artificial intelligence and high-performance computing applications. Since late 2021, Vertiv has more than doubled its manufacturing capacity for power distribution equipment, busway, and integrated power solutions.

kpis.name: Capacity Expansion
kpis.explanation: Expansion of production capacity to meet growing demand
kpis.description: Since late 2021, Vertiv has more than doubled its manufacturing capacity for power distribution equipment, busway, and integrated power solutions through the opening of new facilities worldwide. New facilities include a thermal management plant in India (2024) and a 215,000-square-foot facility in South Carolina (2024).
kpis.signal: Strategic investments in new facilities and increased capacity at existing operations

kpis.name: AI and High-Performance Computing Adoption
kpis.explanation: Development and deployment of solutions for AI and high-performance computing applications
kpis.description: Vertiv has invested in developing new products, services, and solutions to serve growing AI infrastructure demand. The company is increasing its capacity to support additional AI infrastructure demand and will continue investing to support future growth. Innovative designs optimized for rack-scale AI computing enable Vertiv to stay several generations ahead in computing.
kpis.signal: Major investments in product and service development aligned with AI and high-performance computing needs

kpis.name: Thermal Management Portfolio Expansion
kpis.explanation: Expansion of thermal management solutions portfolio for hybrid cooling and AI applications
kpis.description: Vertiv continues to invest in expanding its thermal management portfolio and product capabilities to meet customer demand. The complexity of hybrid cooling (air and liquid) driven by AI workloads presents significant opportunities for innovation and expansion across the entire thermal chain. The new facility in India produces a broad range of cooling products, from in-row and wall units to large direct-expansion and free-cooling systems.
kpis.signal: Ongoing investments in expanding thermal management capabilities and portfolio to address increased complexity of AI workloads

kpis.name: Services and Software Capabilities Growth
kpis.explanation: Expansion of services and software capabilities for lifecycle management and performance optimization
kpis.description: Vertiv sees attractive opportunities in its services business as customers increasingly prioritize reliability, performance optimization, and lifecycle management of more complex, mission-critical digital infrastructure. The growth of AI and high-density computing further increases the importance of services supporting long-term availability, efficiency, and performance. The services portfolio includes project-based and lifecycle offerings with growing emphasis on software capabilities and data analytics enabling earlier customer engagement.
kpis.signal: Attractive opportunities in services related to reliability, performance optimization, and lifecycle management

kpis.name: Strategic Acquisitions
kpis.explanation: Acquisitions to strengthen capabilities, innovation, and technology coverage
kpis.description: Beyond organic growth, Vertiv has expanded its solution capabilities through strategic acquisitions aligned with demand trends. In August 2025, acquired Great Lakes Data Racks Cabinets for approximately $200 million, strengthening rack, cabinet, and integrated infrastructure solutions for AI, high-density computing, and hyperscale environments. In December 2025, acquired PurgeRite to enhance thermal service and system cleanliness capabilities, particularly for hybrid liquid cooling applications.
kpis.signal: Strategic acquisitions aligned with demand trends to strengthen solution capabilities

kpis.name: Research and Development Investments
kpis.explanation: Ongoing investments in product and solution innovation for emerging technologies
kpis.description: Vertiv continues to invest substantially in research and development of new solutions to meet growing demands from AI, high-performance computing, and hybrid cooling. The complexity of architectures driven by AI workloads presents significant innovation opportunities across the entire thermal chain, from chip to heat rejection and reuse.
kpis.signal: Technology leadership through R&D innovation in hybrid cooling, dense computing, and AI

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital investments for manufacturing capacity and operational infrastructure expansion
kpis.description: Vertiv has invested significantly in capital expenditures to strengthen its capabilities in power distribution equipment, integrated power solutions, and thermal management. Investments include opening new facilities (India, South Carolina) and expanding existing operations across more than 40 countries to support growing demand, particularly for AI and high-performance computing.
kpis.signal: Substantial capital investments to support capacity expansion and deployment capability

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Number of employees and expansion of human resource capacity
kpis.description: Vertiv has invested in expanding its workforce to support growing operations and manufacturing capacity. The new facilities in India and South Carolina increase operational capacity and require ongoing investments in skilled human resources to support global operations across more than 40 countries.
kpis.signal: Workforce expansion to support operational and capacity growth

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin as a percentage of net revenue
kpis.description: Vertiv's gross margin reflects profitability of direct sales operations after deducting cost of goods sold. It is indicative of manufacturing efficiency, product mix, and ability to pass through cost increases to customers.
kpis.signal: Profitability and operational efficiency of manufacturing and delivery

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin as a percentage of net revenue
kpis.description: Vertiv's operating margin reflects operational profitability after deducting selling, general and administrative expenses and restructuring charges. It is indicative of overall operational efficiency and the company's ability to generate operating profit from its sales.
kpis.signal: Operating profitability before interest and taxes

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: Vertiv articulates a clear and ambitious strategy centered on AI critical infrastructure and high-performance computing. The company positions AI as a key driver of demand and innovation, making substantial investments in capacity expansion, product development, and strategic acquisitions to serve the AI infrastructure needs of hyperscalers and enterprise customers.
evidence: Business Overview: Leadership in rack-scale AI compute-optimized design, enabling Vertiv to stay several computing generations ahead
Capacity Expansion: More than doubled manufacturing capacity since late 2021, specifically to meet AI and high-performance computing demand
Product Strategy: Designs specifically optimized for AI ('next-gen rack-scale artificial intelligence compute')
Service Enhancement: Growth in services portfolio due to increasing importance of services in supporting performance and efficiency of high-density AI systems
Thermal Management: Significant expansion of air-liquid hybrid cooling solutions portfolio to address complexity of AI workloads
Strategic Acquisitions: Acquisition of Great Lakes ($200M, August 2025) for rack and integrated infrastructure solutions specifically for AI and high-density computing environments
Partnerships: Strategic partnership with NVIDIA for power and thermal infrastructures aligned with high-performance AI architectures
Need for Speed and Scale: SmartRun and Vertiv OneCore portfolios developed to accelerate deployment of large-scale data centers and AI solutions
Market Focus: Explicit mention that AI is a primary driver of current data center sector demand
